purpose: Provide an external guardian layer between TRUMP and each newly discovered obstruction so the proof program can absorb verified lessons without letting the obstruction redefine the theorem target, reset the search, or force an unbounded reaction cascade.

protected_core.target: Determine P vs NP through a valid proof, counterexample to a claimed route, or OPEN verdict; never by narrative escalation.

protector_answer: The bird may strike the route, but it does not get to rewrite the mission. We verify the strike, isolate exactly what died, inherit the lesson, replay every prior defense, and continue from the surviving protected core. One failure changes the next candidate, not the meaning of proof and not the truth value of P versus NP.
formal_shape: SHIELD(TRUMP_n, obstruction) = TRUMP_(n+1) where TARGET_(n+1)=TARGET_n, AUTHORITY_(n+1)=AUTHORITY_n, OBLIGATIONS_(n+1)=OBLIGATIONS_n union {minimal_verified_lesson}, and all inherited obstructions replay before promotion.
anti_watchbird_property: An attacking obstruction may contribute verified information but cannot directly mutate theorem authority, target semantics, proof criteria, or trigger recursive uncontrolled redesign.

required: theorem authority unchanged unless separately proved
